title: Moral Elevation, Empathy, and Group Cohesion: Predicting Immediate Prosocial Intentions in an Online Survey Context

contributions.purpose: 验证道德提升诱导对亲社会的影响
contributions.mechanism: 300 名 Prolific 被试随机分配观看提升/中性视频后测量
contributions.evaluation: 提升组 elevation/empathy/cohesion/prosocial intentions 均显著更高(t(298)≈19-23, p<.001, d=2.24-2.64)
contributions.source_quote: the elevation induction increased reported feelings of elevation, empathy, cohesion, and prosocial intentions

contributions.purpose: 检验共情中介与群体凝聚力调节
contributions.mechanism: 中介 + 调节 + 有调节的中介分析
contributions.evaluation: 共情部分中介;凝聚力增强共情→亲社会效应;间接效应以凝聚力为条件
contributions.source_quote: empathy partially explained the relationship between elevation and prosociality, while moderation analysis revealed that group cohesion strengthened the effect

contributions.mechanism: UNICEF 捐款任务(logistic/线性回归)
contributions.source_quote: elevation did not significantly influence donation behavior, highlighting a gap between intentions and observable altruism

notes: 负结果=意图-行为鸿沟:捐款行为无显著效应(t(298)=0.96, p=.34, d=0.11)。数据红旗:操纵检验及各主效应 Cohen's d 普遍在 2.24-2.64(远超心理学'大效应'0.8 阈值),300 人 Prolific 在线视频诱导得到如此均匀且巨大的效应量,疑似模拟/合成数据,需警惕造数。checklist 内部矛盾:compute resources 答 No 且 justification 写'Not applicable'(应为 NA)。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract 归纳。
